items.title: 21.3.1 Nucleophilic Substitution Reactions (nucleophile ke zariye group ki tabdeeli) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 21.3.1, printed pages 76-78.

blocks.text: Alkyl halides do alag tareeqon se nucleophilic substitution reactions karte hain:

Alkyl halides ke nucleophilic substitution mein do main processes (kaam) hote hain: leaving group ka nikalna (C – X bond ka tootna) aur nucleophile ka attack (C – Nu bond ka banna). Agar dono kaam ek hi step (qadam) mein saath saath (simultaneously) hon to mechanism (reaction hone ka tareeqa) SN2 kehlata hai. Agar dono alag alag steps mein hon, yani pehle step mein bond toote aur doosre step mein naya bond bane, to mechanism SN1 kehlata hai.
i) Nucleophilic Substitution Bimolecular (SN2)

Yeh single step (ek hi qadam) wala mechanism hai. Jaise hi nucleophile substrate (jis molecule par reaction ho raha hai) ke electrophilic carbon par attack shuru karta hai, leaving group wala bond tootna shuru ho jata hai. Yani jitna naya bond banta hai, utna hi purana bond toot'ta hai.

Is mechanism ki doosri ahem baat attack ki direction (simt) hai. Nucleophile leaving group ki opposite (ulti) taraf se attack karta hai. Nucleophile ka attack aur leaving group ka nikalna, sab kuch ek hi waqt mein hota hai.

blocks.alt: OH- se bromomethane ke delta+ carbon ki taraf curly arrow, Br ki opposite side se attack, aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf curly arrow. Phir bracket mein transition state HO---C---Br, negative charge ke saath; phir methanol jis ke teen H doosri taraf palat gaye (O par delta-, C par delta+) + Br-.
blocks.caption: SN2 mechanism: bromomethane aur hydroxide ion (kitab ke PDF page 79 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki SN2 drawing mein C–Br bond ke electrons ka Br ki taraf jane wala curly arrow (mura hua teer) nahi chhapa. Br apne bond ke electrons le kar nikalta hai, is liye hamari drawing mein yeh arrow add kiya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: OH⁻ carbon par Br ki opposite (ulti) taraf, yani peeche se, attack karta hai. Ek hi step mein naya C–OH bond banta hai aur C–Br bond toot'ta hai; bracket wali transition state (beech ki halat) mein dono bond aadhe bane aur aadhe toote hote hain. Product mein teeno H doosri taraf palat jate hain, jaise tez hawa mein chhatri ulat jati hai (inversion).

Is mechanism mein reaction sirf ek step mein hota hai, wahi rate-determining step (reaction ki speed tay karne wala step) hai, aur is step mein do molecules hissa lete hain. Is liye yeh bimolecular (do molecules wala) reaction hai.

Kinetic studies (reaction ki speed ki studies) se pata chala hai ke SN2 reactions ka rate (speed) alkyl halide aur attack karne wale nucleophile, dono ki concentrations (fi volume miqdar) par depend karta hai. Mathematically (formula ki shakal mein):
Aam SN2 reaction second order reaction hai.

Monohalogenoalkanes mein se primary monohalogenoalkanes par jab nucleophile attack karta hai to woh hamesha SN2 mechanism se chalte hain. Wajah steric (groups ki wajah se jagah ki tangi) hai: primary mein substrate carbon par hydrogen atoms ya sirf ek carbon jura hota hai, is liye nucleophile aasani se electrophilic carbon tak pohanch kar attack kar leta hai.
ii) Nucleophilic Substitution Unimolecular (SN1)

Is mechanism ke do steps hain. Pehle step mein alkyl halide aqueous (pani mila) acetone ya aqueous ethyl alcohol mein ionize hota hai (ions mein toot'ta hai); yeh step reversible (ulta bhi chal sakne wala) hai. Is step se carbocation (positive charge wala carbon) intermediate (beech mein banne wali cheez) ke taur par banta hai. Doosre step mein nucleophile is carbocation par attack kar ke product banata hai.

blocks.alt: First Step (pehla step): (H3C)3C-Br, C par delta+ aur Br par delta-, equilibrium arrowon (slow) se satah wala (planar) carbocation + Br- deta hai. Second Step (doosra step): carbocation + OH-, OH- se positive carbon ki taraf curly arrow, fast (tez), (H3C)3C-OH deta hai (Product).
blocks.caption: SN1 mechanism (kitab ke PDF page 80 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle step mein do arrows (⇌) hain kyun ke ionization reversible hai; yeh step slow (sust) hai aur rate tay karta hai. Carbocation ka positive carbon planar (chapta) hai, is liye OH⁻ kisi bhi taraf se attack kar sakta hai. Doosra step fast (tez) hai.

Pehle step mein covalent bond toot'ta hai, is liye yeh doosre step ke muqable mein slow hai. Doosre step mein opposite charge wale ions mil jate hain, jo energy ke hisaab se favourable (aasan) hai. Is liye pehla step rate-determining step kehlata hai. Mechanism ko unimolecular is liye kehte hain ke rate-determining step mein sirf ek molecule hissa leta hai.
SN1 reactions first order kinetics dikhate hain aur in ka rate sirf alkyl halide ki concentration par depend karta hai. In ki rate equation yeh hai:

Tertiary monohalogenoalkanes par jab nucleophile attack kare to woh hamesha SN1 mechanism se chalte hain. Bari wajah stable (mazboot) tertiary carbocation ka banna hai. Is ke ilawa electrophilic carbon par lage teen bare (bulky) groups nucleophile ko leaving group ke peeche se attack karne nahi dete. Is liye substrate molecule SN1 mechanism prefer (pasand) karta hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar carbocations is order mein: tertiary > secondary > primary > methyl. Har positive carbon apne groups ke saath; CH3 groups ke bonds par laal arrow carbon ki taraf. Tertiary par teen CH3, secondary par do, primary par aik aur methyl carbocation par koi nahi.
blocks.caption: Decreasing stability order of carbocations due to decrease in positive inductive effect (+I): +I effect kam hone se carbocations ki stability kam hoti jati hai (kitab ke PDF page 80 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har CH₃ group apne electrons positive carbon ki taraf dhakelta hai (laal arrow, +I effect) aur us ka positive charge kuch kam kar deta hai. Jitne zyada CH₃ groups, utna stable carbocation: tertiary (3) > secondary (2) > primary (1) > methyl (0).

Mechanism batata hai ke rate-determining step mein carbocation banta hai; is liye carbocation jitna stable ho, utni aasani se banta hai. Tertiary carbocations secondary se zyada stable hain, aur secondary carbocations primary se zyada stable hain.
Secondary halogenoalkane solvent (jis liquid mein reaction ho) ki nature (qisam) ke mutabiq SN2 aur SN1 dono mechanisms se react kar sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Tertiary halogenoalkanes SN1 se aur primary SN2 se kyun react karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Tertiary: teen alkyl groups carbocation ko stable karte hain aur peeche se attack rokte hain. Primary: carbocation unstable (kamzor) hota hai, lekin carbon ke gird bheer nahi hoti, is liye nucleophile ek step mein seedha attack kar leta hai.

rows: carbon ke gird jagah khuli (sirf H ya ek carbon)
teen bulky groups peeche se attack rokte hain
primary carbocation unstable, is liye nahi banta
tertiary carbocation stable, aasani se banta hai
ek step: nucleophile peeche se attack karta hai
do steps: pehle carbocation, phir nucleophile ka attack

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: SN2: ek step, peeche se attack, Rate = k[Alkyl halide][Nucleophile], second order; primary halogenoalkanes.
SN1: pehle slow ionization se carbocation, phir fast attack; Rate = k[Alkyl halide], first order; tertiary halogenoalkanes.
Carbocation ki stability: tertiary > secondary > primary > methyl; secondary dono raste le sakta hai.
